request.description: A small airfield office: a brick wall between the office and the hangar, a glass of water on the desk, a helicopter in the hangar, and Sam, a trainee who has never flown.

things: Doorway between the office and hangar
Doorway between the hangar and office
not_modeled: A doorway between the office and hangar, added to give the actors a passable route around the brick wall.

world.label: Airfield Training
world.summary: Sam and a flight instructor share an airfield office beside a hangar with a helicopter and recurring flight-training lessons.

entities.label: Doorway between the office and hangar
Doorway between the hangar and office

actions.description: Move between the airfield office and hangar through a doorway.
Study a waiting flight-training lesson with the instructor.
Drink one serving from the glass of water.
Practice a helicopter flight with the instructor.

mechanics.rationale: Moving through a passable doorway changes the mover's location to the doorway's other endpoint; the checks permit travel from the doorway's first endpoint to its second.

checks.label: you are at the doorway's first place
the destination is the doorway's second place

limits: This mechanic covers only travel from the doorway's first place to its second; reverse travel requires a doorway whose endpoints are ordered in the reverse direction.
The wall is not a passable doorway, so it cannot be used to move.
tests: Sam can move from the airfield office to the hangar through the office doorway when its passable state is true.
Movement is refused if Sam is not at the doorway's first place, the destination is not its second place, or the doorway is impassable.
semantic_bindings: The action's way field is the passage participant.
The action's to field is the destination place.

mechanics.rationale: Studying with the colocated flight instructor uses one waiting lesson and adds flight experience to the trainee; no other study outcome is represented.

checks.label: you are at the lesson board

limits: Studying does not change energy because the description does not specify exertion or fatigue.
The action does not move the trainee, board, or instructor.
tests: A trainee in the hangar can study with the instructor while at least one lesson is waiting.
Study is refused for a non-trainee, without a waiting lesson, or when the trainee, board, and instructor are not all colocated.
semantic_bindings: The lesson_board field is the source of waiting lessons.
The instructor field must identify a colocated instructor.

mechanics.rationale: Drinking one serving consumes exactly one serving from the referenced glass; the action description does not imply another state change.

checks.label: a serving remains in the glass
you are with the glass of water

limits: The glass is not replenished by this action.
The action is refused when the glass has no servings or is in a different place from the drinker.
tests: An actor at the glass can drink when at least one serving remains.
Drinking is refused when no serving remains or the actor and glass are in different places.
semantic_bindings: The water field identifies the glass from which one serving is consumed.

mechanics.rationale: A practice flight with the instructor consumes fuel, records one flight hour, and adds flight experience for the practicing trainee.

checks.label: the instructor is with the helicopter

limits: One practice action consumes one fuel unit and records one flight hour; the description does not specify further costs or outcomes.
Practice is refused unless the trainee, instructor, and helicopter are colocated and fuel remains.
tests: A trainee can practice when colocated with the instructor and fueled helicopter.
Practice is refused for a non-trainee, a non-instructor, different locations, or an empty fuel supply.
semantic_bindings: The helicopter field identifies the aircraft whose fuel and flight hours change.
The instructor field must identify the colocated flight instructor.

processes.rationale: The world has a recurring supply of waiting flight-training lessons; adding a lesson each round keeps lessons available without changing any goods or requiring an actor action.

readout.title: How goods moved through the chain
readout.summary: The instructor and Sam repeatedly moved between the hangar and the airfield office. New training lessons arrived each round and accumulated on the lesson board; no use or movement of goods through a chain was recorded.

mechanisms.name: Goods made from other goods
mechanisms.missing_reason: No goods were made from other goods.

mechanisms.name: Goods carried to the next step
mechanisms.missing_reason: No goods were handed on to a next step.

mechanisms.name: Demand reached and met
mechanisms.missing_reason: No finished goods were shown reaching and being used at their destination.

mechanisms.name: Work held up
mechanisms.missing_reason: No step was shown stalled because needed goods had not arrived or had run out.
